original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚贡贝州确认霍乱疫情，已治疗74名患者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚贡贝州政府在比里里地方政府区托迪选区凯多村宣布霍乱疫情，此前10月4日出现腹泻和呕吐病例并造成两人死亡。州卫生专员表示，已有74名患者接受治疗并出院，简报时无在院病例。州政府已派出快速响应小组支援当地调查并为受影响居民提供免费治疗。该信息目前为单一来源报道。

location.site: 比里里地方政府区托迪选区凯多村
location.raw_text: Kedo village, Todi Ward, Billiri Local Government Area, Gombe State

key_facts.fact: 贡贝州政府在比里里地方政府区宣布霍乱疫情
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Gombe State Government has declared a cholera outbreak in Kedo village, Todi Ward, Billiri Local Government Area

key_facts.fact: 10月4日腹泻和呕吐病例造成两人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: following reports of diarrhoea and vomiting that claimed two lives on October 4

key_facts.fact: 已有74名患者接受治疗并出院，简报时无在院病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 74 patients had been treated and discharged, with no active admission recorded as of the time of the briefing

key_facts.fact: 州政府派出快速响应小组支援当地调查和免费治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the state government immediately deployed a Rapid Response Team to support the local government health team in investigating the outbreak and providing free treatment

uncertainties: 疫情信息目前仅来自单一来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
死亡与病例数字来自州卫生专员简报，未获独立确认
